title: audit detail task.mode_off
description: detail of audit rows with action task.mode_off: a working mode was switched off for a task (target the task; ADR-098 section 3). reason: person (a writer or their agent), session (task.mode off asked by a session; operation_id names it), chooser_left (the person who chose it lost write access to the workgroup). Metadata only; every value is flat.
